text: The account holder Shahid Mirza holds account PK**MUCB****3758 which was opened on 9 August 2018. The subject is a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 185,000 per month. During the activity window from 2 May 2026 to 24 May 2026, there were 12 credits totalling PKR 16,043,000 and 3 debits totalling PKR 12,466,000. The account received 11 cash deposits totalling PKR 15,858,000 at three branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). The activity was flagged by Tazama on 24 May 2026, with a typology score of 320 against a threshold of 300. Repeated cash deposits just below the reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, with 8 of 11 deposits between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999 totalling PKR 14,844,000, are indicative of structuring. Deposits were made across three different branches, which is consistent with structuring activity. There was more than one cash deposit on 13 May 2026, a pattern that can signal structuring. The credits in the activity window were 86.7 times the declared monthly income of PKR 185,000, suggesting cash volume inconsistent with the declared income. The customer declined to explain the source of the cash when asked about the need for extra paperwork for deposits of PKR 2 million or more. Taken together, these indicators are consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 9,691,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank C) in 2 transactions. PKR 2,775,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank B) in 1 transaction. Debits equal to 78% of credits were paid out with a median time of 28.8 hours between the latest credit and each debit. No match was found on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 28 May 2026. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
